title: Validate YAML File
description: Validate YAML syntax using an available parser when installed.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$FILE" || ! -f "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 file.yaml" >&2
    exit 1
fi

python3 - "$FILE" <<'PY'
import sys

try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print("ERROR: PyYAML is not installed.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as f:
    yaml.safe_load(f)

print("Valid YAML")
PY
